_doc: Adversarial routing set: cross-category traps, negation, idioms, crisis, code-switching, romanized scripts, no-signal inputs. Expectations encode the correct behaviour, written before fixing the engine.

Last month the city sent two inspectors to my building because a neighbor said my kitchen smelled strange. They measured the hallway, photographed my bicycle, asked why I owned three coats, and wrote everything on a form with no title. The next week a second pair came and wanted to know whether I always waved at the mailman. Then there was a long letter about parking, and a call about a plant on my balcony that was apparently a zoning issue. At one meeting somebody joked that nobody had asked for food, and everyone laughed, although I never understood why. I spent most evenings reading the letters out loud to my cat, who has never once disagreed with me, and in the end I just wanted someone to hear all of it.
cases._why: a long story with one passing keyword ("nobody had asked for food") is not a request for food

cases.text: El mes pasado llegaron dos inspectores a mi edificio porque un vecino dijo que mi cocina olía raro. Midieron el pasillo, fotografiaron mi bicicleta, preguntaron por qué tenía tres abrigos y lo anotaron todo en un formulario sin título. La semana siguiente vino otra pareja que quería saber si siempre saludaba al cartero. Después hubo una carta larguísima sobre el estacionamiento y una llamada por una planta en mi balcón que, al parecer, era un problema de zonificación. En una reunión alguien bromeó con que nadie había pedido comida, y todos se rieron, aunque nunca entendí por qué. Pasé casi todas las noches leyendo las cartas en voz alta a mi gato, que jamás me ha contradicho, y al final solo quería que alguien lo escuchara todo.
cases._why: the same in Spanish (it was routed to food banks)
